purpose: Map the abstract operations binding entries to repository-scoped configuration of one version control system. Canonical rules stay technology-neutral; this profile is derived guidance, not authority.
scope: Only the configuration owned by the local operations checkout. Never personal, global or system configuration, and never another repository.
procedure: Acquire operations inside the controlled execution envelope with the selected common-private credential.
Write every applicable entry of the profile into the checkout configuration, using absolute credential file locators inside the common private area and the identity registered at bootstrap.
Read every entry back and compare it with the recorded binding; verify the effective principal and, when required, signature acceptance through an ordinary invocation without the envelope.
Record the verified entries as registration operations_binding {profile, entries:[{entry, key, value}]} so the controller can report drift at session opening.

profile.rule: The lowercase command name of the version control system whose repository-scoped configuration the controller binding check can read. Derive every key and value from the official documentation of the actual system and keep the mapping in owned technical state; examples.md shows one conditional mapping.

unknown: An unsupported version control system has no profile: record the limitation and keep the per-invocation envelope; the controller reports operations_binding unavailable.
